description: This source file defines the class 'DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler' which implements the Handler<CommandContext> interface. It handles command messages by delegating them to a downstream peer after retrieving or creating a sender via a supplied BiFunction. It manages sending the command message, handling success or failure, and logging errors with tracing support.

classes.name: DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler
classes.description: A handler for command messages that delegates handling to a downstream peer by creating a sender and forwarding the command message, with logging and tracing support.

methods.name: DelegateViaDownstreamPeerCommandHandler
methods.description: Constructor that accepts a BiFunction to supply DelegatedCommandSender instances for specific tenant and device IDs.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Processes a CommandContext by retrieving the command and delegating it to a downstream peer, managing success and failure cases with logging and tracing.
